rows.detail_main_html:
Astral Form

Psionicist · Level 10

Effect

Partially shifts your physical body into the astral plane, allowing you to absorb 20% of most types of incoming damage. Spiritual effects are more potent in the astral plane and will deal 20% more damage to you.

Learned from

A Psionicist unlocks this by meditating at a gestalt: a place that resonates, which works once and then is spent. Any one of these will do.

  • Ca'ial Brael
    gestalt: Right near Shimmerlake Garrison
  • Hathor Zhi
    gestalt: behind the fort, /loc -73000, -24000, -3900
  • Khal
    gestalt: On the western outskirts, /loc -56000, -38000, 1300
  • Leth Nurae
    gestalt: Next to entrance of the Arcanium dungeon, /loc 58400, -28600, 69100
  • Martok
    gestalt: Behind the Bank K&K, /loc 27954, 51988, 6991
  • Mekalia
    gestalt: Right in the newbie area next to Mengarie Building, /loc 30400, 52700, 4700
  • Tanvu
    gestalt: Just outside of the Tanvu training building

Enthrall I

Psionicist · Level 18 · Mental Alteration

Effect

Takes control of an opponent's mind, forcing them to become your thrall for up to 3 min. Every 20 sec your thrall gets a chance to break free. The higher level the target is compared to your level, the more likely they are to break free. Only Humanoids, Fey, Creatures, Monstrosities and Fiends can be charmed. Only usable on opponents lower than level 31.

Ranks

III 42 ?? Enthrall lasts for up to 7 minutes
